title: Original sources with a specific educational purpose
scope: Future source-based teaching and reading selection; historical generated mechanism tests remain labeled as such.
preferred_material: Original works of recognized scientists, mathematicians, philosophers, and educational writers
Author-written textbooks with clear explanations and assessable prerequisites
Original technical references maintained by the responsible scholarly or standards body
Respected literature only when the chosen passage teaches an explicit, assessable skill or idea
exclude: Poetry or stories selected merely to fill a corpus
Unrelated entertainment, social media, marketing, or generic web text
Anonymous summaries substituted for an available original source
Material without an identified author or responsible scholarly body
Material whose educational role and prerequisite level are unspecified
required_lesson_record: original work, exact edition, source URL, language, and locator
source fingerprint and applicable source terms
literature_rule: Genre alone neither qualifies nor disqualifies a work. A respected literary passage is eligible only for a stated learning goal such as language structure, argument, ethics, or historical interpretation, with appropriate assessment. No filler poetry or fiction.
questions_rule: Practice and test questions may be varied or generated from the admitted syllabus. This does not make generated prose a teaching source. Whole final questions must not have been used for teaching.
selection_rule: Use expertise, scholarly standing, educational value, and primary provenance. Do not claim to rank people by intelligence.
current_limit: The present experiment includes generated foundation checks and supplied operator contracts. It is not yet an original-works-only language curriculum. Word, sentence, and broader source-learning model capabilities must still be implemented.
